thread:
priya: CI alert — audit-event-validator failing on master after the RBAC patch. failing golden fixtures that include actor fields when KMS redaction is enabled. link: https://ci.redwood/example-run/1423 :warning:

priya: sample failure: `ValidationError: 'actor.id' missing (required)` but event shows `actor: { principal: 'service-account' }` (no id) due to key-redaction step in kms-worker.

sec-ci-bot: auto-detected 23 failing fixtures, changed files: audit/goldens/*, validator/schemas/audit_event.schema.json. See job 1423.

dave: ah ok. did the RBAC change rename actor -> principal anywhere? I thought we only added role metadata.

emma: Not rename; we started redacting `actor.id` when the principal is a service principal to avoid leaking customer IDs into logs — that change landed in kms-worker last week. but tests assume actor.id always present.

oliver: Could be two options: (1) make validator accept either actor.id or actor.principal for these golden fixtures, or (2) update goldens to include a redacted marker like "actor.id": "[REDACTED]" so CI matches behaviour.

priya: From a customer-facing audit viewpoint we can't suddenly inject raw ids. option 2 seems safer: canonicalize redaction semantics in goldens. but validator should also be tolerant for older events until we roll.

dave: I can sketch a quick permissive change to the schema: allow `actor.id` to be optional if `actor.principal` present OR require `actor.id` to be oneOf string|"[REDACTED]". Will open PR.

emma: prefer explicit enum for redaction marker so we can detect accidental omissions. e.g. schema: `actor.id` pattern: "^\[REDACTED\]$|^.+$" and also add `oneOf` with presence of principal.

priya: Also lifecycle question: do we need a migration to update persisted golden fixtures? I'd rather update goldens in CI to match runtime now. Anyone want to own updating customer-facing examples/docs?

oliver: i'll take goldens update. will add a small harness to regenerate fails. tagging @emma for validator change review.

priya: pls add a short note in the release changelog re: audit schema redaction so customers doing event replay know what to expect.

sec-ci-bot: Job 1423 rerun scheduled by dave — PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/audit-validator/pull/678

dave: pushed draft PR with schema relax and test fixes. hoping to keep strictness for other fields.

emma: quick snag in CI logs: `error: golden mismatch: actor.metadata.roles: expected ["admin"] got []` — looks like role injection path changed too. opening follow-up ticket to trace role propagation.

priya: ok prioritize: 1) make CI green (PR678), 2) update goldens (oliver), 3) write short customer note + postmortem if fallout. if anyone hits blockers ping me. :thumbsup:

oliver: starting goldens update now. will post checksum and sample diff once ready.

priya: thanks — also add a regression test that simulates KMS redaction (set KMS_TEST_REDACT=true) so we don't flip this again silently.

dave: noted. adding env-based smoke test to the pipeline. ETA EOD my side.

emma: fyi I found one event where `actor` was entirely nulled by an earlier transform; validator should reject that. we'll keep `actor` required but allow id redaction.

priya: perfect. last: create an incident-ticket if we detect any customer replay failures in the next 24h. I'll monitor.

sec-ci-bot: Job 1423 rerun complete — 3 remaining failures tied to role propagation. new ticket: https://issues.redwood/SEC-459

priya: tracking SEC-459. thanks team."
